title: Snooki is ready to connect with 'ghosties' on 'Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie'
excerpt: "Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie" is streaming now on All Reality in the U.S.
content:
Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi is tapping into a different world with her new series, “Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie.”

NEW YORK, NEW YORK - OCTOBER 08: Nicole 'Snooki' Polizzi attends "Dexter" 20th Anniversary Celebration & "Dexter: Resurrection" Season 2 premiere at Chelsea Industrial on October 08, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by Theo Wargo/Getty Images)

The “Jersey Shore” star has had a lifelong love the paranormal, telling PauseRewind’s Kevin Zelman, “I'm obsessed with angel numbers, my horoscope, tarot cards, the moon.”

Naturally, that led to Snooki securing her own ghost-hunting show, the delightfully titled “Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie.”

“This was actually my idea. This was my show that I came up with, and I was trying to sell for you know a couple of years, and nobody was biting at it. And I'm like, why does no one want to see me be a ghost hunter? Like I don't understand. And then yeah, we landed it.”

Snooki’s interest in the paranormal goes back to her childhood, when she says she “felt things.”

Kevin Whitaker and Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi for "Snookie: The Paranormal Rookie." (Courtesy: AllReality)

“I'm very, I guess, sensitive to those things. And then I ended up opening my third eye and trying to be a medium and working on my mediumship. So this was always like a big part of my life,” Snooki said.

She added she’s always been a fan of ghost hunting shows and “always wanted to have my own show, it's just always been a part of my life and something that I've always wanted to do was like ghost hunt and you know go into these well-known haunted places and seeing if I can feel anything, but also like using all the Scooby Doo gadgets to try and collect evidence. Like it was just something really exciting for me to try.”

Snooki fully admits to the “rookie” part of the title, saying, “I was very confused on a lot of things” and that she was “really nervous” at first. But with the help of the show’s team of experts, including Kevin Whitaker, one of North America’s foremost psychic mediums, occult expert and historian Missy Morrow, and tech specialist Todd Thomas, she “conquered my fear.”

Missy Morrow, Kevin Whitaker, Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi, and Todd Thomas for "Snookie: The Paranormal Rookie." (Courtesy: AllReality)

And despite referring to the spirits she encounters as “ghosties,” Snooki shared she does get scared.

“If we go ghost hunting again, I'll be nervous because you never know what you're gonna feel or what you're gonna see or what's gonna happen. It's like the unknown, but I think that's why I like it so much,” she said.

Snooki said she’s always been sensitive to the spirit world and has learned to hone her skills and “trust my instincts.”

“I definitely learned how to turn it on and off because at some points I wasn't sleeping at night, and I still have trouble sleeping at night because that's like the best time for them to want to talk to you,” she said. “So it's really hard for me to sleep. I have to like take melatonin now to try and like sleep throughout the night. But I feel like once you like really open your third eye and you start practicing, it really never turns off. You just have to learn to live with it, I guess.”

Missy Morrow and Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi for "Snookie: The Paranormal Rookie." (Courtesy: AllReality)

Snooki isn’t coming for her fellow New Jersey-based medium, Teresa Caputo, but she is trying to get close and “be able to like sit with someone and be like, okay, I'm going to read you.”

Given her lifelong sensitivity to spirits, did Snooki ever feel any “ghosties” at the “Jersey Shore” house?

“I was like bombed the whole time. So at that point in my life, I wasn't even like thinking about this. You know, even though I did deal with it when I was a child. [The] Jersey Shore House was more of just me being a mess, not looking for ghosts,” she said.

At the moment, Snooki’s process involves meditating and writing down information and consulting with someone she’s reading.

Kevin Whitaker, Missy Morrow, and Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi for "Snookie: The Paranormal Rookie." (Courtesy: AllReality)

She also said she often picks up on her loved ones, like her late step-sister, who “does scare me,” as well as her grandma, grandpa, and uncle.

“Like if I'm stressed, they'll come to me and I feel them. So they definitely give me comfort and like the cozies,” she said.

Of course, when she’s investigating a building, Snooki is prepared to meet “random scary ghosties,” but often finds the children are drawn to her.

“A lot of little kids come to me, and I'm totally fine with that because obviously I'm a mom, I have kids, and I feel like you know these kid ghosties, they just want like a mommy presence, so I'm kind of there to snuggle them a little bit.”

NEW YORK, NEW YORK - JULY 30: Nicole 'Snooki' Polizzi attends the Amazon Kids Back-To-School Runway Show by Rookie Kids at Iron 23 on July 30, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by JP Yim/Getty Images for Rookie Kids)

And by “snuggle” she means she reaches her hand out to comfort and does “feel ghosties touch me, so it's more of like a spider web feeling on you.”

As “Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie” debuts, the mom of three is also celebrating positive health news: she is now cancer free after undergoing a hysterectomy.

“I'm so thankful and just glad that I did everything that I needed to do. I was terrifiedof the surgeries and pain and all the unknown things, but I'm glad I pushed myself and just made myself get everything done because yes, we are cancer-free now,” she said. “It's just like now I just have to really stay on top of my appointments still and just monitor it and make sure you know it doesn't come back.”

She continued, “I mean I always had the saying, ‘if it's my time, it's my time.’ It's like if I die, die, but I can prevent it right now and be healthy. So I think more it's more of just being healthier. So, just like going to the gym more, staying on top of all my appointments, taking vitamins nowJust like being more health conscious.”

“Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie” is streaming now on All Reality in the U.S.
